item.title: Scientists urge governments not to wait for global plastics treaty as pollution continues to grow
item.description: Scientists are urging governments to act immediately on plastic pollution, warning that waiting for a binding Global Plastics Treaty could mean years of damaging delay while plastic waste continues to accelerate worldwide.

item.title: Weighing sustainability of real vs. fake Christmas trees
item.description: As people contemplate their holiday plans, they may find themselves in an environmental quandary, asking: Which is more sustainable, a real or artificial Christmas tree?
